headword: {準備体操|じゅんびたいそう}

definitions.explanation: Light exercises performed before physical activity to prepare the body, prevent injury, and improve performance. A standard part of physical education and sports in Japan.

examples.japanese: {泳|およ}ぐ{前|まえ}に{準備体操|じゅんびたいそう}をしよう。
examples.english: Let's do warm-up exercises before swimming.

examples.japanese: {準備体操|じゅんびたいそう}をしないで{走|はし}ったら、{足|あし}をつってしまった。
examples.english: I got a leg cramp because I ran without warming up.

examples.japanese: {体育|たいいく}の{授業|じゅぎょう}では、まず{全員|ぜんいん}で{準備体操|じゅんびたいそう}をしてから{運動|うんどう}を{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: In PE class, everyone does warm-up exercises together before starting the activity.

notes:
USAGE:
A fundamental concept in Japanese physical education. In schools, students typically perform {準備体操|じゅんびたいそう} at the beginning of every PE class. Many workplaces also do {朝|あさ}の{体操|たいそう} (morning exercises), such as ラジオ{体操|たいそう}.

FORMATION:
{準備|じゅんび} (preparation) + {体操|たいそう} (physical exercises, gymnastics).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {準備体操|じゅんびたいそう}をする (to do warm-up exercises)
- {準備体操|じゅんびたいそう}から{始|はじ}める (to start with warm-ups)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ウォーミングアップ: warming up — loanword, used in sports contexts
- ストレッチ: stretching — focuses specifically on stretching muscles
- {整理体操|せいりたいそう}: cool-down exercises — done after exercise to help the body recover
